content.short: Noah AI is a no-code AI builder for full-stack onchain apps on Solana and Monad.
content.description: Noah AI generates full-stack on-chain applications from prompts, covering both Solana and Monad. Generated contract code deserves the same scrutiny as any other, arguably more, since the person who prompted it may not be able to read what came back.
content.meta: Generates full-stack onchain applications for Solana and Monad from a prompt.
